character.name: Spincubus

traits.title: One unbroken expression
traits.description: The whole program is a single expression, so the filament running through its body never has to pause for a new line.

traits.title: Four imports, light pack
traits.description: It carries only functools, math, ctypes and time, so it travels with very little luggage.

traits.title: Two source files, one soul
traits.description: Only cube.py and shadecube.py live in the folder, so the monster has very few places to hide.

character.originStory: Spincubus haunts a single window, 500 pixels wide, where it turns a wireframe cube without rest. Its diet is pure math, borrowed from the math module and digested in one gulp. Behaviour is the strange part: a glowing filament knots through its whole body, and everything it is fits inside a single expression, so it cannot be interrupted for a loop. Field guides note it keeps no README and prefers shadecube.py for company. Disturb it at your peril, but the spin never stops, because it is still busy being one unbroken sentence.
